# Pulse AI

> AI-native platform that unifies inbox, CRM, telephony, and marketing automation so small businesses and freelancers can capture leads, reply faster, and grow revenue.

Pulse AI brings WhatsApp, email, social channels, calls, and a knowledge-trained AI assistant into one workspace. Teams connect their channels, train the AI on their business, and run campaigns, automations, and analytics from a single dashboard.

- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans, prices, and the 7-day free trial.
